title: FL-LWR SUWANNEE NWR-HEAVY EQUIP RENTAL
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.US FISH AND WILDLIFE SERVICE.FWS, OVER SAT G/S
description_text: FL-LWR SUWANNEE NWR-HEAVY EQUIP RENTAL This is a combined synopsis and solicitation for Equipment Rental for Lower Suwannee NWR, FL. Equipment only, with drop off and pick up. 2 each excavators, 20 ton class 2 each 110 hp skid steers 1 each 920-950 gal diesel fuel trailer See attached solicitation packet for details Vendor will provide a price for the pricing schedule on the attachment and a written acknowledgement that they have the requested equipment available for rent during the request period of time and will pick up the equipment for storage if there is a hurricane. Submit responses to Robert_Sung@ios.doi.gov with "140F0S26Q0023" in the subject line
